recommendation: Keep the source commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-53129 scope without reopening FHIR-23739 or changing FHIR-54833 Provenance.authorization semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-53129 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by Security and asked the Access Control material to mention AuditEvent and Provenance as methods for recording or tracing authorization decisions founded on Consent, including the existing AuditEvent example and new Provenance examples.
initial_application: PR #3952, merged as 14ab71d33601002555732d7e1269b814512d6ae2 after implementation commit 88a96446a80bf3e43352eb8aac8ddd5db8cf54ee, added AuditEvent access-control bullets, a Consent Used subsection, and Provenance/example5 and Provenance/example6. The prior application left the narrative explaining only AuditEvent and left copied comments in the Provenance examples.
additional_context: Security WG minutes on 2025-10-13 and 2025-10-27 frame the work as an Access Control explanation recorded or memorialized by AuditEvent and/or Provenance, with a 6-0-0 approval on 2025-10-27. The 2025-11-10 minutes and FHIR-23739 comments record Patient Care satisfaction and ticket completion. Later FHIR-54833 confirms Provenance.authorization is not the place for Consent/AuditEvent references.
reconciliation: Added Provenance guidance to source/security.html, updated the source/secpriv-module.html Consent Used subsection to cover AuditEvent and Provenance for create/update/delete tracing, linked Provenance/example5 and Provenance/example6, and replaced misleading copied comments in those examples with comments describing their Consent-authorization purpose.
source_changes: source/security.html: added a Provenance access-control consideration explaining Provenance.target and Provenance.entity.what tracing for Consent-founded create/update/delete decisions.
source/secpriv-module.html: retitled and expanded the Consent Used subsection to cover both AuditEvent and Provenance, including links to the AuditEvent and Provenance examples.
source/provenance/provenance-example5.xml: replaced copied Procedure follow-up-note comments with a description of the AuditEvent-mediated Consent authorization example.
source/provenance/provenance-example6.xml: replaced copied Procedure follow-up-note comments with a description of the direct Consent authorization example.

related_jiras.note: Patient Care resolved the CommunicationRequest/Consent request as no-change because Security's FHIR-53129 update addressed the general tracing need.
Later Provenance.authorization work confirms authorization is a CodeableConcept reason/purpose element, so Consent and AuditEvent references stay in Provenance.entity.what.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive Security issue requesting Access Control guidance and examples for AuditEvent and Provenance records of authorization decisions founded on Consent.
evidence_items.learned: The final request requires current source to cover both AuditEvent recording and Provenance tracing for the Consent-based authorization use case.

evidence_items.summary: Minutes record that the access-control explanation should be recorded or memorialized by AuditEvent and/or Provenance and approve FHIR-53129 6-0-0.
evidence_items.learned: Security WG approved a scope that includes Provenance in the Access Control material.

evidence_items.summary: PR #3952 merged the original FHIR-53129 implementation, adding AuditEvent text, a Consent Used subsection, and Provenance examples 5 and 6.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was partially applied before reconciliation, but the current narrative still did not explain Provenance and the examples retained copied comments from another example.

evidence_items.summary: Current source includes active Provenance and AuditEvent resources and Access Control/Security module text where implementers look for this guidance.
evidence_items.learned: The edited source is build-scoped and the Provenance guidance belongs next to the existing AuditEvent access-control guidance.

evidence_items.summary: The Provenance examples reference the related AuditEvent and Consent resources and are listed as Provenance examples.
evidence_items.learned: These examples are the right targets to link from the narrative, but their copied XML comments needed correction to avoid contradicting their use case.

evidence_items.summary: Later Applied issue kept Provenance.authorization as a CodeableConcept reason/purpose element rather than a reference.
evidence_items.learned: Consent and AuditEvent references for FHIR-53129 should remain in Provenance.entity.what rather than being moved to Provenance.authorization.
